definitions.explanation: Finding a disease, problem, or condition at an early stage. Most commonly used in medical contexts about detecting illnesses before they progress.

examples.japanese: がんは{早期発見|そうきはっけん}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Early detection is important for cancer.

examples.japanese: {定期|ていき}{検診|けんしん}は{病気|びょうき}の{早期発見|そうきはっけん}につながる。
examples.english: Regular check-ups lead to early detection of illness.

examples.japanese: {早期発見|そうきはっけん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}のおかげで、{完治|かんち}することができた。
examples.english: Thanks to early detection and early treatment, a complete recovery was possible.

notes:
USAGE:
{早期発見|そうきはっけん} combines {早期|そうき} (early stage) and {発見|はっけん} (detection, discovery). It is most frequently used in medical and health contexts, often paired with {早期治療|そうきちりょう} (early treatment) in the set phrase {早期発見|そうきはっけん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早期発見|そうきはっけん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう} (early detection and early treatment)
- {病気|びょうき}の{早期発見|そうきはっけん} (early detection of disease)
- {早期発見|そうきはっけん}が{重要|じゅうよう} (early detection is important)
